name: subject-email-no-san-excluded-malformed-attribute-valid
description: When there is no SAN and an rfc822 exclude is in effect, an unparseable emailAddress attribute in the subject DN cannot match the excluded subtree (no '@', no domain to compare). The conservative reading mirrors subject-email-no-san-malformed-attribute-invalid's permitted-side 'treat-as-not-permitted' rule: under excludes, treat-as-not-excluded means the chain validates. Validators that bail out on a malformed attribute (treating any unparseable mailbox as rejected) would diverge here and reject regardless of whether the constraint is permit-side or exclude-side.
notes: The expected value is the conservative reading. A diverging validator that rejects (treating malformed attributes as automatic constraint violations on both sides) would surface as a mismatch against this expected value but is also legitimate behavior.
